sprint: BACKLOG.md -- Fix Single-Select Icon-Row Buttons Not Visually Updating on Click (root Studio only)
task: Closes BACKLOG.md's bug line, verbatim, with an attached screenshot: 'Fill style and alignment always shows solid and center as selected even if i change them. the effect is there on object but the state of button does not change.' Root cause, confirmed via direct code reading rather than guessed: js/contextPanel.js's _makeIconChoiceRow (the shared single-select icon-row builder used by both the World-owned Text quick-edit popup's Fill Style/Alignment rows and the Story-owned freeform-text sticker's identical Fill Style/Alignment rows -- 4 real call sites total) computed each button's initial .active class correctly at construction time, but its click handler called ONLY onChoose(val) and never touched the DOM afterward -- leaving every button frozen at whichever one was active when the popup first opened, exactly matching the report. This is a direct consequence of this popup's own established, deliberate architecture: it is built ONCE per selection and never rebuilt mid-edit (unlike js/cardDesigner.js's Refine panel, whose every commit function unconditionally cascades into a matching _refresh*() that re-derives every button's .active state fresh from the live model on every call -- architecturally immune to this exact bug class, confirmed by direct comparison, and the reason the report was scoped specifically to the quick-edit popup, not the Refine panel). The model itself, and the object's own rendered effect, were always correct throughout -- 'the effect is there on object but the state of button does not change' precisely describes a pure view-sync gap, not a data bug. Fixed by mirroring _makeMultiToggleRow's own already-correct pattern (the sibling multi-select row used for Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough, which already toggles its own .active class on every click): the click handler now walks every button in the row, removes .active from all of them, then adds it back only to the one just clicked, immediately before calling the unchanged onChoose(val) -- purely a DOM-sync addition, zero change to any write path, field name, or model shape. Fixes both real-world manifestations with one change, since both share this single function: the World-owned Text popup (Fill Style/Alignment, writing through SceneEngine.setContentOverride) and the Story-owned freeform-text sticker's second-edition popup (Fill Style/Alignment, writing through the sticker's own update()). Verified via a new, decisive Playwright suite (icon_row_active_verify.js, 59 assertions) covering both surfaces: a Fill Style Solid<->Shapes round trip and a full Left->Center->Right->Left Alignment round trip, confirming after EVERY click that exactly one button shows .active and it is the one just clicked, not the one active when the popup first opened. Run as a decisive git-stash A/B against the unmodified baseline before shipping: the SAME test scored 44/59 passing against the bug -- every one of the 15 failures was exactly an .active-class-state assertion (e.g. 'Shapes button now shows .active after being clicked'), with every model-value and click-success assertion still passing -- precisely matching the bug report's own wording; restoring the fix brought it to 59/59. Full regression across 5 directly-relevant existing scratchpad suites sharing this exact popup machinery (bold_toggle_verify.js, bold_underline_strike_verify.js, sticker_text_quickedit_verify.js, world_owned_delete_absent_verify.js, welcome_heading_removed_verify.js) all passing unchanged (85 assertions, 0 failures, 0 console errors), confirming zero regression to any adjacent, already-shipped functionality sharing the same popup. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero World Builder impact -- this fix is confined entirely to root Studio's Context Panel. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to js/contextPanel.js.
